summary: bioAffinity Technologies filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of pre-funded warrants and Series A/B warrants to an institutional investor. The pre-funded warrants are priced at $0.4657 per share, and the warrants have an exercise price of $0.4727, expiring in five years. The issuance includes 8,462,027 shares underlying each tranche. The warrants are exercisable only after stockholder approval, with a 4.99% ownership blocker (increasable to 9.99%). WallachBeth Capital acted as exclusive placement agent. This is a capital-raising transaction, not a classic capital return, but categorized under Capital Returns as a special-situation equity issuance. What to watch: stockholder approval timing and dilution impact on existing shareholders.
